title: EU resumes aid to Ethiopia suspended over Tigray war
summary: In tonight's edition, the European Union is set to resume budgetary aid to Ethiopia, which was suspended when a brutal civil war broke out in 2020. Also, Nigeria’s jet fuel shortage is being driven by disruptions at the Strait of Hormuz that have curtailed global supplies. And final stop for Pope Leo the 14th's four-nation visit to Africa: he's now in Equat…
